title: Revised age for Schöningen hunting spears indicates intensification of Neanderthal cooperative behavior around 200,000 years ago
lineage: Full PMC provider HTML retained. Revises the horizon to about 200 ka, differing from the older approximately 300 ka interpretation; neither is a direct date of the compared stick.

passages.note: Abstract and revised chronology of the Schöningen 13 II-4 Spear Horizon.
